description: This PHP class defines the EmployeeTimesheetModel which is used for serializing Timesheet entities for API responses in the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It includes metadata annotations for API schema and initializes attribute mappings and filters for serialization.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing Timesheet data for API responses, including employee and status information along with timesheet dates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a Timesheet entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings for API serialization.
